content.Title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Task Force Members
content.IntroNote: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development period up to and including 2023.

2022: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.
Research funding from healthcare industry under direct/personal responsibility to department/institution. Bayer: Collaborative systematic review of healthcare coding in HF, Principal Investigator
Protherics Medicines Development: Grant for independent systematic review, Principal Investigator
Bayer: Unrestricted educational grant to the ESC for the STEEER-AF clinical trial, Chief Investigator

Boehringer Ingelheim: Unrestricted educational grant to the ESC for the STEEER-AF clinical trial, Chief Investigator

Other interests: academic research grants from NIHR, British Heart Foundation, EU/EFPIA Innovative Medicines Initiative (BigData@Heart), including industry collaboration from Bayer, Novartis, Servier, the HYVE and Vifor; EU Horizon (HYPERMARKER); industry collaboration from Roche, MedicineMan and Microlife.
